title: RUN TRANSID CHANNEL: the child gets a copy of the channel made at the RUN, a new channel is created empty, an unacceptable name is CHANNELERR

scenarios.summary: PUT CONTAINER, RUN TRANSID CHANNEL, PUT again: the child reads the value from the RUN, the parent its own newer one
RUN TRANSID CHANNEL of a channel that does not exist: created empty, the child sees its name and no container
RUN TRANSID CHANNEL with a character IBM does not accept: CHANNELERR RESP2 1, no child task
